# AI Doc

> AI Doc is durable, project-scoped, evidence-backed memory for software agents. PostgreSQL is authoritative, Azure AI Search is a rebuildable semantic projection, and all cloud access uses Microsoft Entra or managed identity rather than access keys.

Instance-specific, non-secret MCP and Entra configuration is available from [MCP Instance Discovery](/.well-known/aidoc-mcp.json). Agents should read it instead of requesting a client ID from a user.

## Agent Start Here

- [AI Doc for Software Agents](/docs/agent-introduction.md): Product mental model, project and memory entities, agent lifecycle protocol, quality contract, security model, standalone/cloud differences, and current boundaries.
- [Configure AI Doc MCP Locally in VS Code](/docs/local-vscode-mcp-configuration.md): Entra-authenticated Code MCP setup, token-refreshing stdio launcher, tool discovery, validation, and troubleshooting.
- [MCP Installation and Agent Usage](/docs/mcp-agent-usage.md): MCP tool semantics, project bootstrap, complete Markdown upload, memory boundaries, search-before-report, and verification.

## Recommended Agent Reading Paths

- New coding agent: AI Doc for Software Agents → Local VS Code MCP → MCP Installation and Agent Usage.
- Existing Code MCP user: AI Doc for Software Agents → MCP Installation and Agent Usage.
- Connection troubleshooting: Configure AI Doc MCP Locally in VS Code.

## Optional

- [Documentation Home](/docs/): Human-readable navigation for the same raw Markdown resources.
